purpose: Scale-up session at the 15 V operating point (SCALE_UP_PLAN_20260924.md): cardioids of 26 / 44 / 60 mm at 10 Hz with five feedforward designs each, a 28 mm radius w scan, and the 2.5 / 3.0 mm horizontal steps. The limits below were raised on 2026-09-24 with the user's approval; 35 mm is needed because the 60 mm cardioid reaches 30.741 mm from the centre although it stays inside the |x|, |z| <= 30 mm camera box.

experiments.name: kcheck_x_S105_6jumps
experiments.note: Stiffness check at the 15 V operating point: x steps 0 -> +1.05 -> 0 -> -1.05 -> 0 -> +1.05 -> 0 mm, 7 holds of 2.0 s, 6 jumps, 14.0 s. Same command as ff_heart_20260918 so the stiffness values compare across sessions.

experiments.name: kcheck_y_S105_6jumps
experiments.note: Stiffness check at the 15 V operating point: y steps 0 -> +1.05 -> 0 -> -1.05 -> 0 -> +1.05 -> 0 mm, 7 holds of 2.0 s, 6 jumps, 14.0 s. Same command as ff_heart_20260918 so the stiffness values compare across sessions.

experiments.name: kcheck_z_S105_6jumps
experiments.note: Stiffness check at the 15 V operating point: z steps 0 -> +1.05 -> 0 -> -1.05 -> 0 -> +1.05 -> 0 mm, 7 holds of 2.0 s, 6 jumps, 14.0 s. Same command as ff_heart_20260918 so the stiffness values compare across sessions.

experiments.name: vzrstep_XL25
experiments.note: Large horizontal step for the force shape: x only, 0 -> +2.5 -> 0 -> -2.5 -> 0 mm, 3 cycles, 12 jumps, 0.4 s holds (0.5 s at both ends), 5.4 s. Separates a_r and v_xr, which the product k alone leaves degenerate. Horizontal step; the vertical lambda/4 criterion does not apply. The horizontal restoring force is F_r = a_r sin(v_xr d) with v_xr <~ 0.5 /mm, so the force keeps growing out to d = pi/(2 v_xr) >= 3.1 mm and still restores to about 6 mm (analysis side, 2026-09-24). Record 2.5 mm first and confirm the particle is retained before 3.0 mm.

experiments.note: Large horizontal step for the force shape: x only, 0 -> +3.0 -> 0 -> -3.0 -> 0 mm, 3 cycles, 12 jumps, 0.4 s holds (0.5 s at both ends), 5.4 s. experiments.name: wscan_XZ_R28_a
experiments.note: Wide surface scan of the equilibrium-shift field w at 15 V: spiral centre -> 28 mm -> centre in the XZ plane, counter-clockwise, 24 s, no compensation (u = r). Gives the calibration residual (rotation and scale) and w over the whole camera box, and feeds the _Ws4 compensation for the large cardioids.

experiments.name: wscan_XZ_R28_b
experiments.note: Wide surface scan of the equilibrium-shift field w at 15 V: spiral centre -> 28 mm -> centre in the XZ plane, clockwise, 24 s, no compensation (u = r). Gives the calibration residual (rotation and scale) and w over the whole camera box, and feeds the _Ws4 compensation for the large cardioids.

experiments.name: cardioid_a10_f10_OFF
experiments.note: Scale-up cardioid, width 26 mm, 10 Hz, design OFF (u = r (no feedforward)). 15 V operating point (k 0.208/0.198/2.48 1/ms^2, tau0 0.9 ms). Peak speed 1257 mm/s, peak acceleration 118652 mm/s^2, max |u-r| 0.000 mm. The point of the series is whether the non-linear inverse model C_nl beats the linear C once the required force approaches the limit.
